policy: Targeted, independently sourced corrections to a frozen import. These reviews do not certify the rest of the inherited collection or reconstruct exact travel routes.

title.en: Dujiangyan: managing river water and sediment
title.zh: 都江堰：调节水流与泥沙

summary.en: Dujiangyan diverts part of the Min River towards the Chengdu Plain while managing floods and sediment. Its principal works divide the flow, discharge excess water and control the inlet. UNESCO dates the system’s beginnings to around 256 BCE; later dynasties modified and enlarged it. The surviving waterworks therefore represent a long history of maintenance and adaptation, rather than an unchanged structure completed in a single year.
summary.zh: 都江堰把岷江部分水流引向成都平原，同时调节洪水与泥沙。主要工程分别承担分流、泄洪和控制进水的作用。联合国教科文组织的概述将其始建时间定为约公元前256年；后代不断修改和扩建。现存水利体系反映长期维护与调整，并非一年建成后原样保留的工程。

dateNote.en: Approximate starting date, c. 256 BCE, following UNESCO’s brief synthesis. The point identifies the waterworks; it does not date every surviving component or establish Li Bing’s exact movements.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前256年为依据联合国教科文组织概述采用的近似始建年代。点位标示水利工程，不表示现存全部构件均属此年，也不复原李冰的具体行踪。

location.label: Dujiangyan waterworks, Sichuan · 都江堰水利工程

note.en: Reviewed scope: approximate origin, engineering functions and later modifications. The inherited exact-year phrasing and immediate “Land of Plenty” claim have been replaced. This is not an independent archaeological dating of the entire complex.
note.zh: 核查范围：近似始建年代、工程功能及后世改建。原资料的精确年份措辞及随即成为“天府之国”的说法已替换；此项核查并非对整个工程作独立考古断代。

sources.title: Mount Qingcheng and the Dujiangyan Irrigation System
sources.evidenceNote: Brief synthesis gives c. 256 BCE, the three principal engineering functions and later modifications. The page’s criterion (iv) contains a conflicting second-century wording; the review follows the brief synthesis and third-century introductory description.

title.en: Bi Sheng: reusable clay printing type
title.zh: 毕昇：可重复排用的胶泥活字

summary.en: Shen Kuo’s account describes Bi Sheng making separate characters from clay, firing them and arranging them for printing. After a page was printed, the characters could be reused. The Asian Art Museum dates this development to 1041–1048. It formed part of a wider printing culture in which woodblocks continued to serve many purposes; the appearance of movable type did not make woodblock printing disappear.
summary.zh: 沈括记述毕昇以胶泥制作单个字，烧制后排列印刷，印完可以重新排用。亚洲艺术博物馆将这一发展定在1041—1048年。当时印刷文化仍广泛使用雕版；活字的出现并未使雕版印刷立即消失。

dateNote.en: 1041–1048 is the source-supported range, replacing the inherited single year 1047. The retained Kaifeng point is a Northern Song regional reference, not a verified workshop location or proof that Bi Sheng worked there.
dateNote.zh: 依据来源采用1041—1048年区间，替换原条目的单一年份1047。保留的开封点位仅作北宋区域参照，不是经核实的作坊位置，也不能证明毕昇在此工作。

location.label: Northern Song context near Kaifeng; workshop location unverified · 北宋区域参照，作坊地点未核实

note.en: Reviewed scope: the reported 1041–1048 development and clay-type process. The original claim of a precisely dated invention in Kaifeng is not retained. The map point provides regional context only.
note.zh: 核查范围：记载中的1041—1048年区间及胶泥活字工艺。不沿用原资料关于在开封某年发明的精确说法；地图点位仅供区域定位。

sources.title: The Invention of Woodblock Printing in the Tang and Song Dynasties
sources.evidenceNote: Dates Bi Sheng’s movable clay type to 1041–1048 and explains Shen Kuo’s account; does not identify a verified Kaifeng workshop.

title.en: 105: Cai Lun’s reported presentation of improved paper
title.zh: 105年：蔡伦奏呈改进纸张的记载

location.label: Luoyang; representative Eastern Han court location, not Cai Lun’s birthplace

summary.en: Historical accounts associate Cai Lun with presenting improved writing paper to the Han court in 105 CE. Archaeological evidence for older paper means this date should not be presented as the beginning of all papermaking. The distinction matters because written histories can attach a craft practiced by many workers to one court official. The map point is now the representative court center at Luoyang, rather than a birthplace associated with Cai Lun. It identifies the setting of the reported presentation without claiming the location of a surviving workshop.
summary.zh: 史书记载蔡伦于公元105年向汉廷奏呈改进的书写用纸。已有更早纸张的考古证据，因此不能把105年解释为所有造纸活动的起点。这一区别提醒我们：文字史料可能把许多工匠参与的技术发展归于一位宫廷官员。地图点现为代表东汉宫廷的洛阳，而非与蔡伦籍贯相关的地点；它说明奏呈记载的背景，不表示已经找到作坊遗址。

dateNote.en: 105 CE is the traditional court-presentation date; archaeological paper predates it. Luoyang is a representative court location.
dateNote.zh: 105年为传统记载中的奏呈年代，考古纸张早于此时；洛阳为宫廷代表点。

sources.title: The Woman Who Invented Notepaper: Towards a Comparative Historiography of Paper and Print
sources.publisher: T. H. Barrett; Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society / Cambridge University Press
sources.evidenceNote: Inspected scholarly PDF, especially pp.203–204: earlier archaeological paper and the recorded presentation of improved writing paper in 105 CE are distinct claims.

sources.title: Origins of paper
sources.evidenceNote: Indexed institutional text contrasts the Cai Lun tradition with archaeological evidence for earlier paper. Full-page retrieval failed; used as limited corroboration, not as inspected full text.

note.en: Qualified the invention claim and corrected the representative location to match the court-presentation narrative. Oxford corroboration is indexed-only.
note.zh: 限定发明论断，并使代表点与奏呈宫廷的叙述一致；牛津补充来源仅读取到索引摘录。

title.en: 69–70: Wang Jing’s Yellow River and canal works

summary.en: Official historical summaries place Wang Jing’s major Yellow River and Bian canal works in 69–70 CE. Coordinated embankments and channel management linked flood control with transport. The inherited phrase suggesting a thousand years of uninterrupted tranquillity is omitted: a successful engineering episode does not prove the absence of later floods or unchanged geography. Nor should these works be dated to 11 CE merely because a source schematic begins one river-course display window in that year. Engineering chronology and the source map’s display rules are different kinds of evidence.
summary.zh: 官方历史概述把王景的重要黄河、汴渠治理工程置于69—70年，筑堤与水道治理将防洪和运输联系起来。本条删去容易被理解为千年没有洪水的笼统表述：一次工程的成效并不证明此后无灾，或水文地理始终不变。同样，不能因为来源示意图从公元11年开始显示某条河道，就把王景工程定为11年。施工年代与地图资料的显示规则属于不同证据。

dateNote.en: 69–70 CE is a qualified engineering focus based on indexed official accounts; source-defined river display windows are not construction dates.
dateNote.zh: 依据官方索引记述采用69—70年的工程关注期；来源河道的显示窗口不是施工年代。

sources.title: 王景治河
sources.publisher: 黄河水利委员会 / Yellow River Conservancy Commission
sources.evidenceNote: Indexed official account describes coordinated Yellow River and Bian canal works. Full-page retrieval failed; the displayed chronology is a qualified reading of indexed official evidence, not a reconstructed river survey.

sources.title: 王景：河汴同治千载安澜
sources.publisher: 新疆维吾尔自治区水利厅

note.zh: 利用官方索引记述作有限编年限定；全文读取失败，未独立核实边界或河道几何。

title.en: 1433: the final expedition in Zheng He’s seven-voyage series
title.zh: 1433年：郑和七次远航系列的最后一次返航

summary.en: The final expedition in the court-sponsored series returned in 1433. This date anchors the end of that series, rather than proving that every form of seafaring stopped or that a separate maritime prohibition began in precisely that year. The fleets connected ports, carried envoys and goods, and drew on coastal knowledge preserved in later navigational compilations. Surviving maps also have publication histories of their own: the Mao Kun material should not be mistaken for a newly surveyed map from the year of the final return.
summary.zh: 这一宫廷资助的远航系列最后一次于1433年返航。该年用于标记这一系列的终点，并不证明所有航海活动随即停止，也不能单凭它确定另一项海禁政策的起始年。船队连接港口，运载使节与货物，并依赖沿海航海知识，其中一些后来收入航海图编。留存地图也有自身的出版史，不能把茅坤图材料误作最后返航当年新测绘的地图。

dateNote.en: 1433 marks the final return of the expedition series, not a universal end to maritime activity or an independently established policy date.
dateNote.zh: 1433年标记这一远航系列的最后返航，不是所有海上活动的终点，也不是单独核定的政策实施日。

sources.title: Stories from the Stacks: Admiral Zheng He’s Navigation Map
sources.evidenceNote: Inspected lines 105–107 give Zheng He’s dates as 1371–1433/35 and distinguish the later published Mao Kun Map from its earlier navigational material. Used for uncertainty, not proof of a death at Calicut.

note.en: Removed the unsupported immediate causal link between the final voyage and a blanket maritime prohibition.
note.zh: 删去最后一次航行与全面海禁之间未经支持的直接因果断言。

title.en: 1433/35: uncertainty around the end of Zheng He’s life
title.zh: 1433／1435年：郑和晚年年代的不确定性

location.label: Kozhikode/Calicut; representative final-voyage port, not a verified death or burial site

summary.en: The National Library Board of Singapore gives Zheng He’s terminal date as 1433/35. That uncertainty is retained here instead of presenting his death at Calicut in 1433 as a settled event. Calicut was a port in the expedition world, so its representative point can help locate the setting of one tradition; it does not establish his death or burial there. The final-voyage chronology, a person’s lifespan and later commemorative traditions must be evaluated separately. This entry deliberately leaves the disputed ending unresolved.
summary.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆把郑和生平终年写为1433／1435年。本条保留这一不确定性，不再把1433年在古里去世写成定论。古里是远航网络中的港口，代表点可帮助理解一种说法的地理背景，但不能证明郑和死于或葬于此处。末次航行编年、人物生卒与后世纪念传统需要分别评价，本条不对有争议的结局作虚构裁定。

dateNote.en: Focus on competing terminal-date traditions,1433 or 1435. The interval does not assert that Zheng He lived through 1435 or was at Calicut throughout it.
dateNote.zh: 关注1433年或1435年两种终年传统；该区间不断言郑和确实活到1435年，也不表示这几年一直在古里。

description.en: Born at Ruiyun Tower in Yuyao, Wang Shouren asked his tutor at age eleven what the highest pursuit in life was. Told it was passing the imperial exams, he replied: "Passing exams is surely not the highest pursuit; learning to become a sage is."
description.zh: 王守仁诞生于浙江绍兴府余姚县瑞云楼，父王华于1481年高中状元。十一岁随祖父北上京师塾读，问塾师「何为第一等事」，师答「惟读书登第耳」，守仁昂然对曰：「登第恐未为第一等事，或读书学圣贤耳。」自幼立下成圣之志。

note.en: 1472 is the birth anchor. His father Wang Hua's first place in the palace examination was in 1481. The chapter's childhood anecdotes concern later years.
note.zh: 1472年为出生锚点。父亲王华中状元在1481年，并非出生次年。本段所述童年问学故事属于之后的经历。

note.en: 238 BCE is the opening anchor. The Chinese reference places Lü Buwei's dismissal in the next year,237 BCE. This chronicle groups successive developments and does not demonstrate the ruler's personal presence at each mapped campaign site.

description.en: Amid Xiongnu succession turmoil in 126 BCE, Zhang Qian escaped back to Chang'an with Ganfu—only two survivors of the original hundred—opening the Silk Road.
description.zh: 元朔三年军臣单于死、匈奴内乱，张骞与胡妻及甘父逃归长安。出使十三载，百余人唯二人得还，后因军功封博望侯，史称“凿空”。

note.en: 126 BCE remains the return anchor. The title Marquis of Bowang belongs to later service and should not be inferred to have been granted at this return. A precise grant year has not been established in this bounded review.
note.zh: 前126年保留为归汉锚点；博望侯封号属于后来的军功经历，不应推断为归汉当年即获封。本次限量核查未确定授封的精确年份。
